title: Crispy Canadian Goose Bake
description: A delicious and savory dish featuring crispy-skinned Canadian goose, baked to perfection.
instructions: Rinse the Canadian goose and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together bake seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Rub the seasoning mixture all over the goose, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Place the goose in a roasting pan and brush with kissed olive oil.
In a separate bowl, mix together crispy breadcrumbs and chopped onion.
Sprinkle the breadcrumb mixture evenly over the goose, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Place the goose in the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Reduce heat to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for an additional 30-40 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Remove the goose from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before carving and serving.
